instruction.name: xvffint.d.lu
instruction.description: Convert unsigned 64-bit integer elements in `a` to double-precision floating point numbers.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Register-to-register dependency chain. Source values are normal floats or small integers as appropriate.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvffint.d.lu $xr0, $xr8; xvffint.d.lu $xr1, $xr9; xvffint.d.lu $xr2, $xr10; xvffint.d.lu $xr3, $xr11; xvffint.d.lu $xr4, $xr12; xvffint.d.lu $xr5, $xr13; xvffint.d.lu $xr6, $xr14; xvffint.d.lu $xr7, $xr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvffint.d.lu $xr0, $xr8; xvffint.d.lu $xr1, $xr9; xvffint.d.lu $xr2, $xr10; xvffint.d.lu $xr3, $xr11; xvffint.d.lu $xr4, $xr12; xvffint.d.lu $xr5, $xr13; xvffint.d.lu $xr6, $xr14; xvffint.d.lu $xr7, $xr15'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 1.99 cycles. The measured CPI 0.2487 is the nominal 0.25 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: LASX vector conversion. Measured on LA664 with normal float or small integer source values; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000).
